name: Multi-Image Object Hallucination (MIOH)
description: MIOH is a benchmark designed to diagnose object hallucination issues in multimodal large language models across complex multi-image scenarios. It integrates four object-centric tasks with four adversarial factors to evaluate model robustness under challenging visual and linguistic contexts.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark that has seen growing attention in multimodal hallucination research, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on object hallucination in multi-image MLLM settings with adversarial conditions.
